title: Build SCM evidence-to-feature contract, uncertainty representation and leakage controls
whatBuilt: Versioned deterministic evidence-to-feature extraction: fixed feature order (attempt_count, correct_rate, recent3_correct_rate, current_streak, scm_p_known, p_known_delta[reserved+explicitly missing], distinct_sources); vector carries featureVersion + SHA-256 vectorDigest
TRAIN/SERVE PARITY via golden fixtures: committed features-v1.json (3 cases) must reproduce exactly; parity asserted through the shared extractor with digest equality and version-drift refusal
MISSINGNESS EXPLICIT: sentinel -1.0 + missingness mask (empty windows, reserved features); missing scm_p_known refused at the gate — nothing silently zeroed
TIME LEAKAGE CONTROL: cutoff bounds the attempt window; proven by test that cutoff-k extraction equals truncated-sequence extraction for every k (future attempts cannot influence features)

NO FUTURE OUTCOMES / IDENTITIES: buildOutcome and misconceptionLabels in evidence refused at the gate (labels are targets, never features); uid/workspaceId/sessionId refused — identities remain outside neural features
LABEL-SIDE GATE: validate_misconception_labels refuses codes outside the pinned ontology version (VMM-03)
SOURCE LEAKAGE: leakage_report detects shared sourceRefs/contentDigests across a train/eval split; revoked sources gate extraction via the VMM-03 revocation ledger

UNCERTAINTY: Wilson-score interval over the observed correct-rate with wide/moderate/tight banding and an abstain recommendation — few attempts mean wide uncertainty and an honest gather-more-evidence answer

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 52/52 pass (12 supplychain/exposure + 10 seeddata + 10 benchmarks + 9 baselines + 11 features)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: No model is trained or selected by this ticket; golden fixtures regenerate only with an intentional feature-version bump (reviewer-visible). Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
